sample_unit: patient cases (consecutive early breast cancer cases discussed at tumor board)

links.outcome: Accuracy of ChatGPT therapy recommendations versus tumor board decisions for early breast cancer
links.effect: ChatGPT gave mostly general answers, wrongly recommended trastuzumab for Her2 1+ and 2+ (FISH negative) patient; current version unable to provide specific therapy recommendations.
links.quote: ChatGPT wrongly identified the patient with Her2 1+ and 2+ (FISH negative) as in need of therapy with trastuzumab and called endocrine therapy “hormonal treatment”.

links.outcome: Real-case clinical competence of general ChatGPT in tumor board recommendations
links.effect: Despite ability to pass medical exams, ChatGPT could not provide specific therapy recommendations for primary breast cancer cases.
links.quote: ChatGPT has the potential to find its spot in clinical medicine, but the current version is not able to provide specific recommendations for the therapy of patients with primary breast cancer.

screen.reason: Evaluates ChatGPT's recommendations against tumor board decisions on 10 retrospective breast cancer cases without testing a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
